description: A wooden chessboard sits on the table next to an open chess set box with two small plastic bags of pieces inside. The left hand slides in to steady and lift the chessboard while the right hand supports the opposite edge, then the board is rotated over and lowered into the open box as a two-hand object; the right hand then places the bags of pieces on top inside before both hands bring the printed box lid over and press it down to close.
